factor_name: Inverse 20-day momentum scaled by realized volatility

calculation.description: A contrarian cross-asset signal: recent 20-trading-day total return is divided by annualized 20-day realized volatility and direction is inverted, favoring volatility-adjusted recent underperformers. Values are computed using data available at the decision date only.

validation.regime_notes: Inverse-direction performance was positive in all evaluated broad periods after direction reversal: raw IC was -0.073073 during 2026-07-28 through 2027-12-31, -0.010967 during 2028-01-01 through 2029-12-31, and -0.059164 during 2030-01-01 through 2033-11-01. The small cross-section and likely overlap with existing reversal factors warrant conservative incremental-use interpretation.
